files.hint: Projects save automatically as you edit. Previews refresh when you return to Projects.

general.languageDescription: Interface language for the whole app. “System language” follows your desktop setting.
general.autoZoomsDescription: Adds zooms on clicks and typing when a fresh recording opens in the editor.
general.showCursorDescription: New projects draw the recorded cursor over the video.

motion.connectZoomsDescription: Zooms close together glide from one to the next instead of zooming out between them.
motion.zoomInDurationDescription: How long a zoom takes to move in.
motion.zoomOutDurationDescription: How long a zoom takes to move back out.
motion.cursorSwayDescription: How much the cursor tilts as it moves.

recording.micDescription: Cleans background noise from your microphone in new recordings. System audio is not changed. Strong can make voices sound slightly processed.
recording.keysDescription: Shortcuts only skips normal typing. Key presses are saved only next to the recording. Letters follow the US keyboard layout.
recording.micSaveFailed: Could not update microphone noise reduction
recording.keysSaveFailed: Could not update key press capture
recording.fpsDescription: How many frames are captured each second. 60 is smoother; 30 makes smaller files and is easier on slower machines. Applies to the next recording.
recording.fpsSaveFailed: Could not update the frame rate
recording.qualityDescription: Standard keeps files small, High is the balanced default, Lossless-ish keeps every detail but files get very large.
recording.folderDescription: Where new recordings are saved. Existing recordings stay where they are.
recording.folderSaveFailed: Could not update the recordings folder

permissions.captureHint: Choose what to capture when you start a recording.
permissions.mediaDescription: Access is requested when you enable a microphone or camera for recording.

shortcuts.title: Global shortcuts
shortcuts.cosmicDescription: Work in every app. Gravaai adds them to COSMIC's keyboard shortcuts for you.
shortcuts.portalDescription: Work in every app. Your desktop asks you to confirm them once; change the keys in its keyboard settings.
shortcuts.cliDescription: Your desktop doesn't let apps add shortcuts. Bind these commands in its keyboard settings:
shortcuts.captureNote: While you pick a shortcut, a combination already used by a Gravaai shortcut also triggers it.
shortcuts.invalidBinding: Use Super, Ctrl or Alt with a key
